_comment: Universal hook registrations every Core must have. apply-shared-hooks.py idempotently + additively merges these into each Core's .claude/settings.json. WHY THIS EXISTS: hook *scripts* live in the shared .claude/hooks/ dir (they rsync to every Core + fork), but their *registration* lives in settings.json, which is per_core_keep and NEVER propagates. So a fork gets the scripts on disk but unwired — recall + the discipline gates never fire. This merge is the transport for the wiring. Keyed on the `match` substring of the command: a hook is added only if NO existing entry in that event already contains `match`. Entries land in each event's matcher-'' block. STRICTLY ADDITIVE — never removes, reorders, or edits per-Core entries. The trust-root pretooluse-guard is NEVER auto-registered (per_core_keep, manual install by design); task-brief-reminder/tracking-orphan-guard stay per-Core (matcher-specific, minor). PreToolUse EXCEPTION (2026-06-09, Nick-approved): approval-gate.py IS auto-registered on PreToolUse — it is a non-trust-root binding BEHAVIOR gate wanted on every Core, self-filters tools internally (blocks only mutating tools while armed; read-only tools pass, so a matcher-'' registration is safe), and is brain-verified stateless + env-var-driven. This does NOT touch pretooluse-guard (different match key).
